culturalBackground: Moroccan and other North African henna traditions rely on lines, diamonds and triangles rather than flowers.
Geometric pattern is central to Islamic art, which favours repeating, non-figurative designs.
Modern minimal mehndi often uses geometric shapes with plenty of bare skin around them.
Symmetry is what makes a geometric design work, so spacing matters more than detail.
applicationTips: Mark light guide dots first so the lines stay evenly spaced.
Draw straight lines in one steady pull instead of several short strokes.
Keep line thickness consistent; uneven lines stand out more in geometric work than in florals.

faqPool.q: Where do geometric mehndi designs come from?
faqPool.a: They are strongest in Moroccan and North African henna, and are now also common in modern minimal styles everywhere.

faqPool.q: Are geometric designs harder than floral ones?
faqPool.a: The shapes are simple, but they need straighter lines and more even spacing, so mistakes are easier to see.

faqPool.q: Can geometric and floral mehndi be combined?
faqPool.a: Yes. A geometric band or grid next to a floral motif is a common modern combination.
